messages:
maya: Quick sync — finalizing speaker kit + lead routing for the webinar about 'serving LLMs at scale'. Need confirmations on owners and deadlines.
rachel: I can own the speaker kit (bios + headshots + slide template + mic checklist). Target Wed EOD to send draft.
alex: I'll own lead routing -> HubSpot workflow + Slack alert. Need list of confirmed speaker orgs to tune scoring rules.
sam: Confirmed speakers: @dr_singh (ML Eng), @elena_product (PM), @todd_infra (Infra). Rehearsal availability: Tue 10am PT ok for everyone?
rachel: Tue 10am PT works. I'll include a short "how to join" doc (Zoom links, passcodes, co-host settings). Also mic check tips: check levels, avoid headphones with echo, enable 'original sound' if needed.
maya: Draft run-of-show (timing):
1) 5m - host intro + agenda + sponsor mention
2) 20m - demo + architecture deep-dive
3) 20m - panel Q&A (moderated)
4) 10m - closing CTA + poll results + next steps
Thoughts on distribution? I want enough Q time to drive follow-ups.
elena_product: +1 to extra Q time. Demo to 20m sounds right; keeps momentum and more time for feedback.
maya: Slides due Fri noon. Please use the template in the speaker kit and include 1 slide with your top 3 takeaways & 1 CTA.
alex: Proposed HubSpot workflow (simplified):
```json
{"trigger":"webinar_form_submit","filters":{"webinar_topic":"llm_serving","company_size":">50"},"actions":[{"assign_to":"AE_inbound"},{"add_to_list":"webinar_0426_attendees"},{"webhook":"https://hooks.slack.com/services/T/.../B...","payload":{"channel":"#inbound-webinar","text":"New webinar lead: {{email}} (score: {{lead_score}})"}}]}
```
I'll route registrant pings to #inbound-webinar and tag high-score leads for AEs.
andrew_sales: Lead scoring guidance: +10 if job_title contains Engineer/CTO/VP Eng, +5 if company_size >200, +15 if visited pricing or docs before sign-up. Tag all attendees with 'webinar_0426' for nurture.
maya: Rehearsals schedule:
- Tue 10am PT: tech check (audio, screen sharing, recording) — 30m
- Thu 11am PT: dry run (full run-through) — 60m
Please RSVP in this thread by EOD tomorrow.
rachel: I'll assemble the speaker kit packet: slide upload link, speaker bio form (consent + pronouns), headshot request, mic checklist, and a 5-min presenter notes template. Sending draft now (link in thread).
deploy-bot: Reminder: recording will be on. Please confirm consent on the speaker bio form; recording will be used for on-demand.
maya: Backup plan: if a primary speaker needs to drop, @todd_infra can present a 10-15m fallback on infra resilience and we can splice a pre-recorded demo clip. Anyone else able to cover 10-15m as backup?
elena_product: I can cover 10m if needed; prefer to keep demo flow intact though.
maya: Action items (short):
- rachel: send speaker kit + collect headshots (Wed EOD)
- alex: implement HubSpot + Slack zap, test with sample lead (Mon)
- all speakers: upload slides by Fri noon
- ops: confirm registration email + consent checkbox + post-webinar recording delivery
Please react with :thumbsup: when you see this.
sam: :thumbsup:
andrew_sales: :thumbsup:
rachel: :thumbsup:
file_note: webinar ops thread: speaker kit + hubspot routing + rehearsals
